Host own_curve on the native store at 5k. Set hash and UTXO count match the native-store oracle. utxo_load moved 3 ms to 4 ms, inside timer noise.

Host own_curve on the native store at 50k. Set hash and UTXO count match the native-store oracle. Commit is 2203 ms against the hinted txid64 shadow's 1778 ms, while wall time is 21763 vs 21264 and set_hash_fold is 359 vs 367. The commit gap is not script and not the 25 ms rehash timer.

Host own_curve on the native store at 100k. Height, hash, UTXO count 13154991, and set hash match the native-store oracle, including after reopening the datadir. Commit is 37057 ms against the unhinted txid64_mix c_binding run's 36669 ms. utxo_load is 5097 vs 4305 and rehash_ms is 782 vs 702; both counters sum sub-millisecond batches, rehash_count stays 22, and wall time is 340252 vs 352455. script_verify is 171470 ms against the canonical c_binding 116901 ms.
Docker own_curve on the native store at 5k. Set hash and UTXO count match the native-store oracle. Commit is 271 ms against the hinted txid64 docker shadow's 209 ms, and wall time is 2329 vs 2486.

Host rung-0 mempool replay of the live trace on native and RocksDB. Verdicts, mutations, and eviction passed, and the two stores agreed on every boundary set hash.
Host rung-0 templates from that same replay. All six templates passed testblockvalidity. Fee ratio against Core is diagnostic.

Host ReleaseSafe own_curve proof for finality, BIP68, required nBits, and the BIP94 timewarp. The restored native mempool replay kept the rung-0 verdicts.

Campaign closed. Quiet ECDSA ratio_min is 1.931; the load-12.7 value 1.667 is withdrawn. The two-accumulator 5x52 field reached 1.844, below bar, not worse, and was reverted without being evidence that 5x52 does not work in Zig. The remaining ~1.8x against libsecp is scheduling inside and around the multiply, and stays open. optimized stays unset.
